description.narrative: This is a six months project, which is a response to cyclone Freddy. The core objective of the project is to strenthen early detection and treatment of severe wasting and other forms of life threateneing acute malnutrition in under five children. The projects outcome is scaling up and strenthening of early detection and refferal of severe acute malnutirion cases. Key activities: Conducting mass nutrition screening to determine nutrition status of children strenthening coordination mechanism at the district level and central levels to ensure a well-coordinated response based on the lessons learned over the years. Support Health Surveillance Assistants (HSAs) and care group volunteers to conduct nutrition counselling of caregivers of children 6-23 months to maintain adequate diets for children, pregnant and lactating women in the camps and communities through the Care Group approachRollout of the expansion of the Social Cash Transfer Programme to respond to Cyclone Freddy•Full Council Meeting•Community Sensitisation and horizontal expansion targeting & payments
